Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. The basic mechanical package is uncomplicated, with a focus on low mass and direct responses rather than elaborate electronics. This generation uses independent suspension at all four corners, and the chassis has long been known for its balanced road manners. Fuel economy was respectable for a sports car of this size, and the engine's output was sufficient for everyday use and relaxed back-road driving. Finished in eye-catching Habanero Orange Metallic with a contrasting Beige convertible top and distinctive Beige/Black Pepita interior, this two-owner local trade-in is anything but ordinary!  The Beetle Coast Convertible celebrates everything drivers love about Volkswagen's legendary design. Its unmistakable rounded silhouette, cheerful personality, and classic 17-inch Heritage alloy wheels create a timeless look that turns heads wherever it goes. The vibrant orange exterior and beige soft top make this particular Beetle especially memorable.  Under the hood, Volkswagen's responsive 2.0-liter TSI turbocharged four-cylinder engine delivers an impressive 174 horsepower and 184 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission featuring Tiptronic manual-shift capability, this Beetle offers lively acceleration, comfortable cruising, and an engaging driving experience.  With an EPA-estimated 26 MPG city and 33 MPG highway, you'll enjoy plenty of efficiency along with the excitement of turbocharged performance.  Of course, the real magic happens when the top goes down! The power-operated convertible roof transforms this Beetle into the perfect companion for sunny Pacific Northwest afternoons, scenic waterfront drives, and weekend escapes. The contrasting Beige roof adds classic character, while the glass rear window provides practical visibility when the top is raised.  Inside, the Coast edition delivers a distinctive combination of vintage-inspired design and modern comfort. The unique Beige and Black Pepita two-tone cloth seats feature an eye-catching pattern that perfectly complements the Beetle's retro personality.  Heated front comfort seats make chilly mornings more enjoyable, while air conditioning, cruise control, remote keyless entry, and convenient steering-wheel-mounted controls provide everyday convenience.  The 6.3-inch touchscreen audio system features AM/FM/HD Radio, CD playback, SiriusXM capability, and an eight-speaker sound system. Whether you're cruising with the roof down or commuting through town, your favorite soundtrack is always part of the experience.  A rearview camera adds confidence when backing into parking spaces, while the compact dimensions and responsive steering make this Beetle easy to maneuver through busy streets and tight parking areas.  Despite its playful personality, the Beetle Convertible remains surprisingly practical. Comfortable front seating, usable rear seats, and a dedicated trunk provide flexibility for shopping trips, weekend luggage, and everyday essentials.  What makes this example particularly appealing is its mileage. With just 54,592 miles, this Beetle has traveled an impressive 15,775 miles less than the market average! Combined with its local trade-in history, distinctive Coast styling, and desirable turbocharged engine, it represents an exciting opportunity to own a truly unique convertible.  For shoppers looking for something beyond an ordinary commuter car, this Beetle delivers personality, efficiency, comfort, and open-air excitement in one unforgettable package.  Offered by Honda of Kirkland, backed by more than 30 years of serving the greater Seattle and Kirkland communities with transparency, customer care, and a no-pressure approach.
